text: Find the radar feed CSS and the markup of the feed, plus how .ops-app children are laid out.
command: cd /work/apps/canvas/src && grep -rnE 'radar-feed|radar-.*feed|feed' --include=*.css . | head -30; grep -rnE 'radar-feed|className="[^"]*feed' --include=*.tsx . | head -10; grep -n 'ops-app' ops/OpsApp.tsx | head
